India asks WhatsApp to pause username feature over fraud concerns

The Indian government has issued a notice to Meta, the parent company of WhatsApp, requesting a pause on the rollout of its new username feature. The government cited concerns over potential identity theft and fraud. WhatsApp has reportedly stated that it will not assign popular names to others and will block attempts at misuse. The government has asked for a detailed response within three days and for safeguards to be explained before consultations conclude.
